subject: Processor ownership and cloud data boundary recap
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Price <amelia.price@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-22T22:10:00Z
Subject: Processor ownership and cloud data boundary recap

Hi Amelia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can close the security/ops questions for procurement: 

Key takeaways from the call:
- HealthBridge currently routes PII -> Redwood for real-time inference only; no long-term storage on our side (TTL 2 hours).
- Primary cloud provider: AWS us-east-1; backups to GCP us-central1 (multi-cloud).
- HealthBridge is SOC 2 Type I (completed 2026); Type II in progress with completion expected Q4 2027.
- HIPAA: you indicated an internal review is underway; possible requirement for a BAA.

Requests we discussed (action items):
1) Subprocessor roster (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring vendors) in CSV form — please include each vendor, role, data types processed, and region.
2) Any current SOC 2 evidence timeline and which controls are in scope (especially CC6/CC7 equivalents).
3) Clarify whether customer data egress rules require strict regional residency for any subset of records.
4) If HIPAA applies, confirm whether HealthBridge will ask Redwood to sign a BAA and the expected date.

Next steps (proposed):
- If you can share the subprocessors CSV and SOC2 timeline by end of day Friday (2027-09-24), Monica will compile a mapping to Redwood's subprocessor roster and call out any gaps.
- Karthik to run a quick mapping of data flows once we have the CSV and will follow up with suggested technical mitigations (encryption, VPC peering options).
- Tentative follow-up call next week to walk through the mapping and any redlines (I can host Wed 09/29 11:00am PT if that works).

Attachment references: ideally the CSV as described and any SOC2 timeline doc (sample filename: hb_soc2_timeline_q4_2027.pdf).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

--
Markus Klein
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Forwarding Amelia's CSV + SOC2 timeline. Preliminary notes after a quick scan: 

- CSV looks complete; vendors listed include: AWS (us-east-1), GCP (us-central1), Segment (US), Datadog (US), Sentry (US-based SaaS). Some vendor rows missing "data retention" fields — we should ask for that.
- Key ask for procurement: confirm whether encryption at rest is enabled for backups in GCP (the CSV shows backups are handled by a third-party).
- There's a line item referencing an analytics partner in EU; scope question whether any EU-origin PII flows to US. If so, we need a lawful basis mapping for GDPR and possibly SCCs/DPAs.

Action items I propose: 
1) Markus: ask Amelia to add retention periods for processors missing that field and to flag any processors that process EU-origin data.
2) Karthik: prepare a short checklist of technical mitigations we can propose (VPC peering with private endpoints, customer-managed KMS, restricted service accounts).
3) Laura: can you prep a one-page procurement note on typical BAA clauses we see and an estimate for time-to-execute (legal review + counterparty).

I'll draft the short follow-up to Amelia (below) — sending once Markus signs off.

--
Monica
Security & Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference

Amelia — appreciate the quick share. Two brief asks to keep procurement moving: 

1) Can you update the CSV with retention periods for the entries missing that column and flag any processors that explicitly process EU-origin data? That will let us determine whether SCCs/DPA addenda are required.
2) For backups in GCP: can your infra lead confirm whether backups are encrypted with customer-managed keys or platform-managed keys? If customer-managed, please include the KMS key region.

Internal notes / responsibilities: 
- Monica will validate vendor roles and identify any high-risk processors (target EOD 2027-09-27).
- Karthik will produce a 1-page technical mitigation doc (VPC peering, CMK recommendation, minimal scopes) by 2027-09-28.
- Laura will share a BAA procurement playbook and typical timeline (legal + counterparty) by 2027-09-29.

Proposed next call: Wed 2027-09-29 11:00am PT — please confirm availability and I'll send a calendar invite. If Amelia confirms the CSV updates by EOD Friday we should be in good shape to present a redline path for procurement next week.

Thanks everyone.
